simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֵין חֲרֹד (H5878) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: עֵין חֲרֹד (ʻÊyn Chărôd) means En-Charod , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Judg 7 1.

definitions.full: H5878. en Charod חֲרֹד proper name, of a location only ח ׳עֵין (see below עַיִן ), a camping-place of Gideon and Israel. Judg 7:1 .
definitions.rootNote: from 5869 and a derivative of 2729 ; fountain of trembling;
